opening.argument: The video is presented as a scheduled television drama, with the description announcing, "New series \"Word\" every Monday at 20:00 at Star !!" Its stated subject is a "Special Force Team," and the dialogue describes soldiers forming an operation against a terrorist organization: "To destroy the terrorist organization, a team of soldiers who are not on duty will be established." The material is correspondingly dramatic and narrative-driven, including reports of injuries and deaths during an attack, military figures in hospital settings, and personal relationships. Nothing in the sampled dialogue or scenes indicates a financial offer or collection of personal data.
